summary: Apollomics Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, with XBRL tagging for share capital, warrants, convertible note, share-based payments, and related-party items; no transaction or corporate action is announced. The exhibit references historical SPAC elements (Maxpro Capital Acquisition Corp. warrants, PIPEs, Project Max SPAC Merger Sub) and subsequent-event tags for subscription agreements and a CFO matter, but these are disclosure tags rather than a new deal. No terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. Watch for future 6-K disclosures on financing or leadership developments.
